name: The Last Beach
description: The Last Beach was the final project for my "3D Animation and Asst Production" class. You are a citizen who has been gifted a ticket to the last beach, yet not even herer you're allowed peace.
contribution: Created all models and textures except for the water which was yoinked off the Unity Asset store.
I had to write a shocking amount of code for this project.
notes: I am quite proud of this one as a work of art. I have always loved these gritter environments, but this one also captures the a real sense of scale that combines with it's supernatural undertones to give it a real lovecraftian feeling I adore.
The manniquine remains one of my favorite creations, his name is Bob.
